newsitem.title: THAILAND: For Thai politician, it's polls before marriage.
newsitem.headline: For Thai politician, it's polls before marriage.

text.p: Thai politician Orathai Kanchanachusak has put off her wedding so she can run in the November 17 national elections.
"I feel my vow to serve the public is more important than personal affairs, so we decided to postpone the marriage from next month to next year," Orathai told Reuters.

The popular 26-year-old Bangkok member of parliament from the Palang Dharma Party said she had planned to wed the son of Thailand's powerful army chief in November. But when parliament was dissolved unexpectedly by Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa late last month she changed her plans.
"We had discussed our wedding plans before the no-confidence debate but everything changed after that," Orathai said.
